title: EventEnvelope
description: Common envelope of every Kafka event (Flow 2). The Kafka record key is payload.order_id, so all events of one order stay in one partition and in order. The value is JSON; no __TypeId__ header is needed, each consumer knows the type of its topic.

event_id.description: Deterministic: a name-based UUID of the business id (payment_id or policy_id). Re-publishing the same fact gives the same event_id, so the consumer's consumer_inbox recognises it.

correlation_id.description: Business correlation id created by order-service; consumers put it in the MDC.
